fields.materials: buildings: wall material families holding 10 % or more of the walls (count per building, and the mixes); with heavy (stone, black marble, grausten) and light walls both, the heavy below (mean height 0.3 m lower), above, and where the heavy walls give way to light ones on top of them; with a plinth, whether heavy walls stand at the foot of all four sides
fields.roofs: twoFamilies: buildings with two slope families of 10 % or more, the minor family 0.5 m or more lower on average, the main family the steeper; buildings with 6 or more roof pieces: one slope family on 90 % of them, one roof material on 90 %, the lead slope and material, slope families with 10 % or more
fields.bays: lines of 3 or more posts (same wall line, same foot, gaps 6 m or less): gaps all equal within 0.15 m, the gap of even lines; buildings with 75 % of their lines even
fields.symmetry: share of walls, roofs, posts, doors and windows with a same piece at the mirrored place across the building middle (better axis), per building; formal: 0.8 or more; door on the axis (within 1.1 m) where the score is 0.6 or more
fields.ornament: carved heads (wood_dragon1, darkwood_raven, darkwood_wolf): builds, pieces, share near a roof (8 m), of those within 2.5 m of the highest roof piece near it, share with a twin (same piece, same height, on one line across)
fields.doors: buildings with 2 or more outer doors: dressing score per door (posts, beams over, roof over, lights, banners, stairs, a gate); one door clearly richest (2 or more points over the next), all equal; the richest door on a long side
fields.village: builds with 3 or more buildings: share of buildings holding the lead wall material, the lead roof material, the lead roof slope, and all three
